decision_rule: Battery R3/R4/R5 rules (as R6-A): a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact (opening lines), lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; a clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Bottleneck guesses are corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant (ordering not checked on them). Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached (no live page, no archive). 'listed <date>' for board stamps is allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17); 'read <Month> <day>, <year>' is allowed where the cited row's retrieved_date carries it, and such undated 'read' clauses are treated as neutral for newest-first ordering (SCHWING, IROCK, Supreme, Construction Attachments). Dated aggregator or expired copies written in the past tense with their own date are not 'as live' (R5-A JTS Nampa precedent: Epiroc Ooltewah Robot Operator I, Supreme Vaia copy). Two-address or city-level wording with the caveat written in (Standard Iron) is not a site misattribution when the facts are on stated rows of the plant (R6-A PPI Pella precedent).
